opportunities.title: WotC Says No to the Union — What the Refusal Actually Means Under Labor Law
opportunities.why_now: WotC's formal non-recognition of the new union is breaking today and reporters are already speculating — the actual legal mechanics (NLRB election vs. voluntary recognition) are being glossed over.
opportunities.angle: Explainer breaking down what 'declines to recognize' means procedurally, what options the union has next (NLRB petition), and precedent from other game-industry unionization attempts

opportunities.title: 13 OMENS Is Live: The Paizo Horror Rules You Need to Read Before You Back It
opportunities.why_now: Kickstarter just launched, meaning backers are deciding right now whether to commit money before fully understanding the system changes from standard Pathfinder/Starfinder horror subsystems.
opportunities.angle: Rules-first breakdown of 13 OMENS' core horror mechanics (sanity/omen tracking, GM tools) pulled straight from the campaign page, written as a 'should you back it' rules audit

opportunities.title: Project_Lamordia on D&D Beyond: What Actually Changes When Survival Horror Hits 5E Rules-as-Written
opportunities.why_now: The content just dropped live on DDB, giving a concrete, playable ruleset to dissect immediately rather than speculate about.
opportunities.angle: Mechanical teardown comparing Lamordia's survival-horror subsystems (resource scarcity, fear/stress mechanics) against core 5E chassis — what's reskinned vs. genuinely new rules

opportunities.title: This Week in Print: Ars Magica, Daggerheart, Scalemail & Pirate Borg — The Rules Changes Hiding in the Roundup
opportunities.why_now: A single roundup post bundles multiple system updates/releases that deserve individual rules attention before they scroll past readers.
opportunities.angle: Serialized 'rules digest' format — one short, fact-dense paragraph per title extracting the actual mechanical changes/new content, not just announcement summaries

opportunities.title: Solo Gamebooks Are Back: The Mechanics Behind Playing a Slasher Killer or a Cyborg Alone
opportunities.why_now: Two new solo adventure gamebooks just launched, and solo-play rules design is a perennially underexplained niche worth demystifying now.
opportunities.angle: Mechanics-focused look at how each gamebook handles solo resolution (dice-based branching, stat tracking) — framed as 'how do these rules actually work' rather than a review
